registryPurpose: Machine-enforced classification of every method exposed by the pinned official YouTube Discovery documents. Classification is not a claim that a provider capability is enabled, proven, approved, or customer-visible.

authority.productBoundary: Native MoolSocial Flutter and backend integration only; this registry does not authorize WebView product UI, service enablement, OAuth publication, deployment, quota use, or provider claims.
authority.verificationPolicy: Any official method addition, removal, or Discovery revision change fails the read-only verification gate until founder-governed classification is updated.

implementationCheckpoint.boundary: This is a local implementation-coverage checkpoint only. It is not evidence of live provider proof, OAuth approval, quota approval, deployment, founder UI acceptance, or customer availability.

availabilityDefinitions.implemented-local: A local adapter/client or test path exists, but this is not evidence of live provider proof or customer availability.
availabilityDefinitions.disabled-gated: The official method has an approved potential product use but remains disabled behind the phase, consent, compliance, quota, and proof gates.
availabilityDefinitions.eligibility/partner-only: The method depends on channel eligibility, a Google/YouTube program, content-owner authority, a provider-issued token, or comparable provider grant.
availabilityDefinitions.unsupported-customer-value: The official method exists but no approved MoolSocial customer outcome justifies product exposure.
availabilityDefinitions.deprecated/excluded: The method is a test-only, deprecated, unsafe, or permanently excluded surface and must not appear as a customer capability.

scopeDefinitions.public-api-key: Public read plane using a restricted server credential when the method and parameters permit it.
scopeDefinitions.owner-readonly: Connected-channel OAuth read access; the narrowest read scope must be requested.
scopeDefinitions.owner-force-ssl-write: Connected-account OAuth write access requiring the YouTube force-SSL/write boundary.
scopeDefinitions.membership-creator: Creator channel-memberships entitlement scope and eligible channel.
scopeDefinitions.analytics-or-monetary-readonly: Analytics read access, with monetary scope only when a separately approved metric requires it.
scopeDefinitions.reporting-or-monetary-readonly: Bulk Reporting read access, with monetary scope only when separately approved.
scopeDefinitions.provider-granted-linking-token: Provider/program-issued linking token or partner grant; ordinary OAuth is insufficient.
scopeDefinitions.no-auth-public: Official method requires neither customer authentication nor quota according to its method contract.
scopeDefinitions.excluded-readonly-test: Discovery advertises a read scope, but the endpoint is test-only and excluded from product use.
scopeDefinitions.partner-or-owner-write: Eligible owner/content-owner or partner authority is required before the write is valid.
